edges.reason: Constructor reads maintoken to instantiate the token interface
Constructor writes tokenReward = token(maintoken)
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial privileged administrator
Constructor writes admins[msg.sender] = 1
Fallback reads admins[msg.sender] to decide whether the caller bypasses payout logic
Fallback uses msg.sender as the caller to be paid
Untrusted msg.sender is stored into state variable user
tokenReward state variable is the target of the balanceOf external call
user address is passed as the argument of balanceOf
Return value of balanceOf is stored into usertoken
now (block.timestamp) gates the payout condition, making execution timestamp dependent
dividendstart is compared against now in the eligibility condition
usertoken is checked (usertoken != 0) before paying out
user is used as the key when reading/writing the users mapping
users[user] is read in the eligibility condition to prevent double claims
usertoken is an operand of the unchecked multiplication
dividends1token is an operand of the unchecked multiplication
Multiplication result is stored into userether (plus msg.value)
Computed userether is passed into the external transfer
user is the recipient of the external transfer
External transfer to an untrusted address happens before users[user] is set to 1, so a re-entrant call could claim dividends repeatedly
The external transfer can call back into the payable fallback before state finalization
Fallback executes the dividend transfer in the main branch
Fallback executes the refund transfer in the else branch
Fallback triggers the external token balanceOf call
Fallback performs the dividend multiplication
Fallback writes users[user] = 1 to mark the claim as used
user is the recipient of the refund transfer of msg.value
owner is read in the require check of admin()
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole authorization for admin()
admin() writes admins[_admin] = _value
owner is read in the require check of out()
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole authorization for out()
out() executes owner.transfer(this.balance) draining the contract
owner is the recipient of the full-balance transfer
Parameter _admin is used as the mapping key written into admins
Parameter _value is used as the mapping value written into admins

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _admin has no independent semantics; it exists only as the key written into admins inside the owner-only admin() function and can be merged into that core function node
Parameter _value has no independent semantics; it only carries the value written into admins[_admin] inside admin() and can be merged into that core function node
